measurement_basis: Targeted regression test, complete capability-intelligence test module, static checks, and bounded live serialization after integration.

outcome.interpretation_limit: The test establishes the response-size bound for representative oversized service and Doctor histories; it does not establish lower agent burden or quality of unobserved responses.
outcome.regression_assertion: The summary projection, including its content digest, serializes to no more than 8000 bytes while retaining the two recorded result references and reporting five omitted no-result rows.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment capability-intelligence test suite and read-only ECI projection
